For centuries, Christians have been told that hell is an eternal torture chamber in the core of the earth—where the lost scream in agony forever. But what does the Bible actually say? In this in-depth Bible study, we dig into Old and New Testament scripture to uncover the shocking truth: the wicked will be completely consumed, reduced to ashes, and never live again.
Using dozens of Bible verses—straight from Genesis to Revelation—we dismantle the popular myth of eternal conscious torment and reveal the loving, just character of God. You’ll discover:

Why no one is burning in hell right now
When and how hellfire actually takes place
The difference between the first death and the second death
How “forever and ever” in scripture does not mean never-ending torture
Why Sodom and Gomorrah are the Biblical example of final judgment
What the Bible means by “unquenchable fire” and the “Lake of Fire”
God’s ultimate plan to make a new heaven and a new earth with no more pain
📖 Key Passages Covered: Revelation 20 & 21, Luke 17:28-32, 2 Peter 2:9, John 5:28-29, Malachi 4:1-3, Psalm 37, Matthew 13:40-42, Daniel 12:1-2, Romans 6:23, Ezekiel 28:18-19, Jude 7, and many more.
This is not just a doctrinal debate—it’s a liberating truth that reveals God’s mercy, justice, and love. If you’ve struggled with the idea of a God who would torture people forever, this study will open your eyes and set your heart at peace with the truth of His Word.

⚠️ Two choices remain: Eternal life or the second death.
✝️ Accept Christ today, and you will never fear hell again.
